models.L041: Qualitative total-water-potential ranks. Hair/smooth comparison changes contact only, not gradient or measured rate. One inward root route; outward/equal do not continue inward to xylem. Parallel apoplast/symplast and complete cross-section omitted.
models.L042: Water follows root/stem/leaf then vapour; sugars use two separate source/sink scenarios. Source/sink are roles, not anatomical identities. Arrows denote paths, not real speed, pressure or tissue arrangement.
models.L043: Actively net CO2-assimilating leaf, fixed temperature/light/wind and internal humidity. Both air cases below internal vapour level. Aperture imposed, not predicted from humidity. Narrowing limits access but does not infer zero loss; no numerical rates or actual animation-time relation.
models.L044: One ovule/seed and one of double-fertilization events tracked. Compatible branch assumes successful subsequent tube/fusion/development; incompatible landing has no tube/fusion/seed. Pollen stays at stigma while sperm is delivered. No yield or viability probability.
